title: melandrium virginicum

It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Melandrium virginicum include iridoids, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
